product.title: Private Tour of Yellowstone Lower Loop

description.text: A private seven- to eight-hour lower loop from West Yellowstone hits the park's southern highlights without the crowds of large coaches. Your guide sequences Old Faithful, Grand Prismatic Spring, Hayden Valley, and canyon rim stops for photography and wildlife viewing at a comfortable pace.

highlights: Private lower loop tour from West Yellowstone
Old Faithful and Grand Prismatic Spring boardwalks
Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone rim stops
Flexible photo time at each viewpoint

start.description: Pickup from West Yellowstone area hotels. Confirm your party size when booking the private vehicle.

end.description: Return to West Yellowstone after the canyon and geyser basin loop completes.
